feed.title: Anixa Biosciences CEO Amit Kumar buys $8,250 in ANIX common stock By Investing.com
feed.summary: Anixa Biosciences CEO Amit Kumar purchased 3,000 shares of ANIX common stock for $8,250 on September 10, 2026. This insider transaction occurred despite the stock trading near its 52-week low and being considered overvalued by InvestingPro analysis. The company has recently made progress in its ovarian cancer CAR-T therapy and breast cancer vaccine clinical trials, securing a South Korean patent for the latter.

feed.title: CTO Realty Growth acquires Kansas City property for $63.3m By Investing.com
feed.summary: CTO Realty Growth Inc. has acquired Zona Rosa, a mixed-use center in Kansas City, Missouri, for $63.3 million. The 768,000-square-foot property is 67% leased and includes major tenants like Dick’s Sporting Goods and Barnes & Noble. This acquisition brings the company's year-to-date property acquisition volume to over $200 million.

feed.title: Corebridge Financial (NYSE:CRBG) Major Shareholder Life Insurance Co Nippon Buys 176,300 Shares
feed.summary: Life Insurance Co Nippon, a major shareholder in Corebridge Financial (NYSE:CRBG), recently purchased an additional 176,300 shares for nearly $6 million, increasing its stake to 122.3 million shares. This follows a previous purchase of 136,466 shares. Corebridge Financial shares are trading near a 52-week high, and the company reported strong quarterly EPS, announced a $0.25 per share dividend, and maintains a "Moderate Buy" consensus from analysts.

feed.title: DHT Holdings secures 3-year charter at $100,000 per day
feed.summary: DHT Holdings, Inc. announced a three-year time charter agreement for its VLCC DHT Panther at a rate of $100,000 per day. The contract with an unnamed global energy company is set to begin in October 2026. DHT Holdings operates an independent crude oil tanker fleet, primarily focusing on the VLCC segment.

feed.title: News | RTX names Jill Albertelli as President, Pratt & Whitney
feed.summary: RTX (NYSE: RTX) has announced the appointment of Jill Albertelli as president of Pratt & Whitney, effective January 1, 2027. She will succeed Shane Eddy, who is retiring. Albertelli, with over three decades of experience at Pratt & Whitney, most recently served as president of Military Engines, and her leadership is expected to guide the company's future growth.

feed.title: Eversource Energy Invites Public to Listen to Webcast of Wolfe Research Conference
feed.summary: Eversource Energy announced that its Chairman, President, and CEO, Joe Nolan, will participate in a webcast at the Wolfe Research Utilities, Midstream & Clean Energy Conference 2026 on September 30, 2026, at 9:20 a.m. EDT. The company invites investors and the public to listen to the live webcast or access a replay on Eversource's Investors page. Eversource is recognized for its commitment to sustainability and corporate citizenship, serving approximately 4 million customers across three states.

feed.title: Franklin Templeton switches fund to Putnam
feed.summary: Franklin Templeton Australia is appointing Putnam Investment Management LLC as the responsible manager for its Franklin Global Growth Fund, renaming it the Franklin Putnam Global Core Equity Fund. This change will lower management fees from 0.90% to 0.60% per annum and reposition the fund from a concentrated growth style to a more diversified core global equity strategy. The move is driven by evolving investor preferences for lower-cost, diversified global equity options, with all changes expected by October 14.

feed.title: Raymond James bank segment president to transition to consulting role By Investing.com
feed.summary: Raymond James Financial announced that Steve Raney, President of its Bank Segment for 21 years, will transition to an executive consulting role on January 1, 2027. Chief Operating Officer Scott Curtis will assume leadership of the Bank Segment, adding it to his current responsibilities. Under Raney's leadership, the bank segment's annual net revenues grew significantly from $41 million to nearly $1.8 billion.

feed.title: Danaher declares $0.40 quarterly dividend By Investing.com
feed.summary: Danaher Corporation announced that its Board of Directors has approved a quarterly cash dividend of $0.40 per share of common stock. This dividend is scheduled to be paid on October 30, 2026, to shareholders who are on record as of September 30, 2026. Danaher is a global life sciences and diagnostics company with approximately 60,000 employees.

feed.title: Jim Cramer Says Adobe (ADBE) Could Be a Short-Squeeze Candidate
feed.summary: Jim Cramer identified Adobe (ADBE) as a potential short-squeeze candidate, noting its resilience and growth despite conservative forecasts. The company reported strong fiscal third-quarter revenue, with AI-first ending ARR exceeding $650 million and growing over 150%. However, there are bear concerns regarding slowing recurring-revenue momentum and increased competition from AI-powered design platforms.

feed.title: Jim Cramer on Procter & Gamble (PG): “They Don’t Have the Growth That I Want”
feed.summary: Jim Cramer expressed his reservations about Procter & Gamble (PG), stating that it lacks the growth he desires despite its 3% dividend yield, leading him to recommend selling the stock. While P&G benefits from strong operational execution, pricing power, and significant cash returns to shareholders, it faces headwinds from weak top-line momentum and challenging consumer trends. Cramer's sentiment is further supported by the stock's modest growth trajectory and premium valuation, prompting a reallocation of capital towards faster-moving opportunities.

feed.title: Highwoods to Release Third Quarter 2026 Results Tuesday, October 27th
feed.summary: Highwoods Properties, Inc. (NYSE:HIW) announced it will release its third-quarter 2026 financial results on Tuesday, October 27th, after the market closes. A conference call for investors and interested parties will follow on Wednesday, October 28th, at 11:00 A.M. Eastern time, with details provided for both US/Canada and international callers, as well as a live webcast link on the company's website. Highwoods Properties is a publicly-traded REIT focusing on office real estate in major U.S. business districts.

feed.title: Blackstone Mortgage Trust Declares $0.47 Per Share Dividend
feed.summary: Blackstone Mortgage Trust, Inc. (NYSE: BXMT) has declared a dividend of $0.47 per share of Class A common stock for the third quarter of 2026. This dividend is payable on October 15, 2026, to stockholders of record as of September 30, 2026. Blackstone Mortgage Trust is a real estate finance company that specializes in originating, acquiring, and managing senior loans and other debt investments related to commercial real estate.

feed.title: Camden Property Trust Announces Third Quarter 2026 Dividend
feed.summary: Camden Property Trust (NYSE: CPT) has declared a third-quarter cash dividend of $1.06 per share for holders of record as of September 30, 2026. The dividend is scheduled to be paid on October 16, 2026. The company, an S&P 500 member, owns and operates 168 multifamily apartment communities across the U.S., with plans to expand to 171 properties.

feed.title: Coca-Cola to spend $10B on US manufacturing by 2030
feed.summary: Coca-Cola and its bottlers are set to invest $10 billion in US infrastructure by 2030 to meet rising demand, encompassing new and existing production, distribution, and office facility expansions. This investment follows an independent study revealing Coca-Cola's significant economic impact, contributing $85 billion to the U.S. GDP and supporting 1 million jobs. Despite recent restructuring and layoffs, the company is focusing on growth areas like AI and emerging brands.

feed.title: FIS stock hits 52-week low at 37.4 USD
feed.summary: Fidelity National Information Services Inc (FIS) stock has fallen to a new 52-week low of $37.40, marking a 43.6% decline over the past year. Despite the downturn, InvestingPro data suggests the stock is significantly undervalued, with a P/E ratio of 5.78, and the company has maintained dividend payments for 24 consecutive years, offering a 4.61% dividend yield. Analysts have issued cautious outlooks due to weaker guidance in the Capital Markets sector, leading to several downgrades and revised price targets for FIS.

feed.title: Why is Jack Henry & Associates stock sliding today? By Investing.com
feed.summary: Jack Henry & Associates (JKHY) stock fell 6.0% today, reversing gains from the previous session's bullish analyst rating. Despite a KeyBanc analyst initiating coverage with an "Overweight" rating and a $190 price target, concerns about the company's near-term profitability outlook, including expected margin pressure and decelerating revenue growth, continue to weigh on investor sentiment. The broader market decline also contributed to the fintech stock's vulnerability.

feed.title: KTUP ETF Analysis: Dividends, Returns BOATS:KTUP
feed.summary: This article provides an analysis of the T-REX 2X Long KTOS Daily Target ETF (KTUP), detailing its structure, investment strategy, and key financial metrics. feed.title: Amex accelerates its encroachment on business banking
feed.summary: American Express is enhancing its business banking offerings to compete with traditional banks and fintechs for small business clients. The company launched a high-yield business savings account, plans to integrate reward redemptions for its Graphite Business card members, and will introduce an AI-powered payroll system in early 2027. These initiatives are part of Amex's strategy to expand its full-service small business relationship by integrating banking, payroll, and payments into a single platform, especially as banks are increasing their small business lending.

feed.title: MarineMax (NYSE:HZO) Hits New 12-Month High - Here's What Happened

The company's latest quarterly earnings and revenue missed expectations, though institutional investors hold a significant 92.85% stake.

feed.title: Micron Appoints Deirdre Hanford to Lead Micron Research Labs
feed.summary: Micron Technology, Inc. has appointed Deirdre Hanford as corporate vice president and president of Micron Research Labs. Hanford will be responsible for establishing the research institution's infrastructure, operating model, partnerships, and defining its research agenda. Micron Research Labs, announced in August 2026, is a global research institution backed by a $10 billion investment and aims to drive breakthroughs in memory, compute, and AI.

feed.title: IRT’s purchase of Centerspace driven by scale, diversification
feed.summary: Independence Realty Trust (IRT) has acquired Centerspace, creating an $8.1 billion REIT. The acquisition aims to enhance IRT's scale and diversification, integrating Centerspace's Midwest and Mountain West properties to complement IRT's Sun Belt focus. This move is expected to generate significant annualized synergies, primarily from corporate and administrative efficiencies, and improve access to capital markets.

feed.title: ResMed stock jumps 3% on RBC Capital upgrade to Outperform
feed.summary: ResMed Inc. (NYSE:RMD) saw its shares climb 3% after RBC Capital Markets upgraded the medical device maker's rating from Sector Perform to Outperform. Analyst Craig Wong-Pan raised the price target to $262, citing ResMed's market leadership in obstructive sleep apnea devices and expected benefits from increased market awareness. The upgrade also considers a class 1 recall for a competitor's device, which is anticipated to further support ResMed's growth.

feed.title: Canterbury Park Holding Corporation Announces Quarterly Cash Dividend
feed.summary: Canterbury Park Holding Corporation announced a quarterly cash dividend of $0.07 per share, payable on October 14, 2026, to stockholders of record on September 30, 2026. This translates to an annual dividend of $0.28 per common share. The company owns and operates Canterbury Park Racetrack and Casino in Shakopee, Minnesota, and is also engaged in developing its underutilized land for mixed-use opportunities.

feed.title: Patrick Dempsey Is the New Face of Guardant Health’s ‘The Reckoning’ Campaign
feed.summary: Patrick Dempsey is spearheading Guardant Health's new multi-million dollar "The Reckoning" campaign, urging early colorectal cancer screening with Guardant's Shield™ blood test. The campaign highlights the rising death toll from colorectal cancer, particularly among younger adults, and promotes Shield™ as the first FDA-approved primary blood test for screening. Dempsey, a long-time cancer advocate, aims to reduce screening barriers and honor those affected by the disease.

feed.title: Biogen (BIIB) and AbbVie (ABBV) Get Wolfe Upgrades—Which Pharma Stock Has More Upside?
feed.summary: Wolfe Research upgraded Biogen (BIIB) and AbbVie (ABBV) to Outperform, assigning both $300 price targets due to undervalued pipelines and low valuations. Biogen's upgrade is driven by late-stage clinical programs and strategic M&A, while AbbVie's is based on strong patent positions and robust cash generation, particularly with its immunology drugs. The report contrasts their risk profiles, with Biogen offering higher upside potential linked to clinical catalysts and AbbVie presenting a more stable, longevity-focused investment.

feed.title: Chipotle Mexican Grill (NYSE:CMG) Stock Price Down 6.7% - Time to Sell?
feed.summary: Chipotle Mexican Grill (CMG) stock dropped 6.7% to $34.56, with trading volume 41% below average, as it tests support levels amid consumer-discretionary weakness and profit-taking. Despite the dip, the company is pursuing aggressive long-term growth with plans for up to 370 new restaurants in 2026 and an expanded Apprentice program. Analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating with an average price target of $43.84, even as valuation remains elevated and international expansion carries execution and valuation risks.

feed.title: Boeing (BA) and RTX (RTX) Gain From Pentagon Missile Buildup, But Is the Upside Priced In?
feed.summary: The Pentagon has signed framework agreements with Boeing (BA) and RTX (RTX) to increase production of SM-3 interceptors, part of a broader U.S. missile buildup. While both companies benefit from the government's commitment to replenish missile inventories, the market's subdued reaction suggests that much of the upside might already be factored into their stock prices. RTX, with its record backlog and prominent role in missile defense systems, appears to be a more direct play on this theme compared to Boeing, which also deals with commercial aviation issues.

feed.title: Why Galveston Is Becoming a Cruise Capital Outside Florida
feed.summary: Galveston is rapidly expanding its cruise port operations, attracting major cruise lines like Carnival and Royal Caribbean with its proximity to 46 million potential passengers in Texas and surrounding states. This growth, fueled by significant port investments, is positioning Galveston as a major cruise hub, offering a convenient drive-to option for travelers in the middle of the country and bringing a distinct local flavor to cruises.

feed.title: Broadridge expands to offer crypto and tokenized investments
feed.summary: Broadridge (BR) has announced an expansion into crypto and tokenized investments, allowing its clients to view these assets alongside their traditional stocks and bonds within the same portfolio. This move aims to integrate digital assets more seamlessly into existing investment management platforms. Scott Melker discussed this development on "The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker."

feed.title: Norwegian Cruise Line contacted individuals on the Do Not Call Registry, a new class action lawsuit alleges
feed.summary: A new class action lawsuit has been filed against Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd. by Irene Sorriento, alleging the company made unsolicited telemarketing calls to her cellphone, which has been on the National Do Not Call Registry since 2004. The complaint, filed on September 10, 2026, claims Sorriento received two vacation sales calls in April 2026, violating the Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA). The lawsuit seeks to represent a class of individuals who received multiple calls from Norwegian Cruise Line while their numbers were on the Do Not Call Registry, asking for damages and an injunction to stop future calls.

feed.title: Jim Cramer Says “Target’s Doing Better than Walmart Right Now”
feed.summary: Jim Cramer commented on Walmart and Target, suggesting that Target is currently performing better than Walmart. He advised a nuanced buying strategy for Walmart due to its valuation, while acknowledging Target's stronger comparable sales momentum. Despite Cramer's view, hedge fund data indicates more funds hold Walmart than Target.

feed.title: What’s Behind Monte Rosa Therapeutics (NASDAQ:GLUE) Latest Slide?
feed.summary: Monte Rosa Therapeutics (NASDAQ:GLUE) has experienced a market slide, putting renewed focus on its clinical-stage biotechnology business. The company specializes in molecular glue technology to selectively remove disease-causing proteins, a distinct approach in drug development. Recent weaker quarterly figures and ongoing clinical development are contributing factors to the pressure on GLUE, highlighting the significant financial resources required for its scientific platform and pipeline advancement.

The company is seeking more scale to advance the Australian project.

feed.title: Greene County Bancorp redeems $10 million of subordinated notes

feed.title: Hive Digital Technologies Ltd's Buzz High Performance Computing Inc. Announce Appointment of Hubert Marleau as Independent Director
feed.summary: Hive Digital Technologies Ltd. and its subsidiary BUZZ High Performance Computing Inc. announced the appointment of Hubert Marleau as an Independent Director of BUZZ HPC. Marleau brings over five decades of experience in Canadian capital markets and governance to the board, aiming to strengthen independent oversight as the company expands its sovereign AI infrastructure platform. His extensive background includes roles at major financial institutions and directorships in numerous public companies.

feed.title: Flex finalizes spinoff plans with corporate structure shakeup, new company name
feed.summary: Flex, a major Austin-based manufacturing company, is finalizing plans for the spinoff of its Axiom Solutions division. The separation, which will include a corporate structure shakeup and a new company name, is expected to be official by early next year and will also involve a CEO change. Flex is known for manufacturing products for large companies like Apple, Dell, and Microsoft across various industries globally.

feed.title: There’s 1 Smart Reason to Upgrade Your iPhone to Apple’s Latest Software Today
feed.summary: Apple has released iOS 27, iPadOS 27, and macOS 17, with the most significant upgrade being the new Apple Intelligence-enhanced Siri. This updated Siri is designed to be a more capable and personal assistant, leveraging AI for improved context understanding, broader world knowledge, and system-wide app actions. The enhancement also includes better dictation skills with on-device processing for data security, making it a valuable tool for both personal and business users.

feed.title: Caterpillar expands VA quarry autonomy
feed.summary: Caterpillar and Luck Stone are expanding their autonomous haulage system to two additional Virginia quarries, marking the first deployment of the technology on Cat 775 trucks. This expansion builds on 18 months of successful autonomous hauling at Luck Stone's Bull Run Quarry, where the technology has moved over 3.5 million tons of material, proving its effectiveness in quarry environments. The collaboration aims to enhance safety, improve production consistency, and develop new skills for associates in technology-focused roles.

feed.title: U.S. Air Force and Northrop Grumman Assemble Inert Missile, Progress Toward Sentinel Flight Testing
feed.summary: The U.S. Air Force and Northrop Grumman have successfully assembled an inert Sentinel missile in its operational orientation, marking significant progress toward flight testing in 2027. This vertical assembly demonstrates the missile's design integration and validates the processes for safe assembly and eventual deployment. The Sentinel program is a crucial modernization of the nation's strategic nuclear triad, aiming for initial capability in the early 2030s.

feed.title: Walmart Turns Pharmacists Into Health Ambassadors in Rural Pilot
feed.summary: Walmart is launching a six-month pilot program in rural communities across five states, transforming pharmacists into "health ambassadors." These trained pharmacists will offer personalized health coaching on topics like nutrition, sleep, and stress, and connect customers with relevant Walmart health services and community resources. The initiative aims to make health resources more accessible and actionable in medically underserved areas.

feed.title: Truist Financial Corporation
feed.summary: Truist Financial Corporation announced it is selling $5.5 billion in auto loans as part of CEO Mike Lyons's strategy to restructure the bank and divest less profitable, non-core assets. This move aims to overhaul the U.S. bank's operations.

feed.title: Huntington Bank promotes executive likely to become its next CEO
feed.summary: Huntington Bank has named Brant Standridge as its new president, positioning him as the likely successor to current CEO Steven Steinour, who will remain in his role for several more years. This move is part of a long-term succession plan following a period of significant growth for the bank, including recent acquisitions and new sports partnerships. Standridge's promotion reflects his deep banking experience and role in advancing the bank's growth agenda since joining in 2022.

feed.summary: Uber is set to lay off 138 employees at its Sunnyvale engineering campus as part of a larger company-wide restructuring, which will eliminate approximately 3,300 jobs globally. The affected employees are located at offices on Mathilda Place. This move is part of ongoing workforce reductions at the tech giant.

feed.title: John Deere dealer Murphy Tractor names next president after Buckles' retirement
feed.summary: Jeff Oldham has been appointed as the new president of Murphy Tractor, a Park City-based John Deere dealer, succeeding the recently retired Bill Buckles.
